gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.appa_guh: Rarity: One per human, and he picks them himself
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.appa_guh: A sky bison with a guh snout: six legs, an arrow from his forehead to the tip of his flat tail, and two soft round guh ears above his horns. As big as a barn, as sweet as a guh. Click to get on; say 'yip yip' (jump) and he takes off, sneak and he sinks. He flies slower than Guh Wings, but he never gets tired and he does it anywhere. Three friends fit in his saddle basket: other humans, or your own guhs (click with a guh on your arm or on a lead). Sneak + click: the saddle chest. A pat on his flank and your guhs roll back out. Lost him? Blow your Appa Whistle. He always comes, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.momo_guh: Rarity: One per human: he picks the shoulder with the most nibbles
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.momo_guh: A flying lemur with enormous round ears, a ringed tail and big green guh eyes. He lives on your right shoulder and picks up everything lying within six blocks: hop, into your bag. What you throw away yourself he politely leaves alone. Now and then he 'borrows' a cheese nibble from your bag. You get it back. Really. Sneak + click a block with an empty hand and he stays there at home; sneak + click him (or sneak and blow your Appa Whistle) and he flutters back to your shoulder.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.lore: You can't hear a thing. One very big, very fluffy friend can.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.tooltip: Blow: your Appa Guh comes to you. Anywhere in the Guh End; elsewhere only at your own Appa Platform.
item.guhs.appa_fluitje.tooltip.momo: Sneak + blow: your Momo Guh comes back to your shoulder.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.opstappen: You sit on %s's head. Jump = yip yip, sneak = down.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.instappen: You climb into %s's saddle basket. %s steers. Hold on tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.vol: The saddle basket is full. Not even a skinny guh fits in.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.guh_erop: %s hops into the saddle basket. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.guhs_eraf: Hup, off you go! Your guhs roll out of the saddle basket.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.blijf_zitten: Nyeg! You don't jump off a flying Appa Guh. Land first.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.kist_niet: This saddle chest belongs to %s. The Appa Guh stares at you until you take your hand away.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.wild: An Appa Guh without a human. He sniffs you, but he is waiting for somebody else, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.wijst: %s points the way: %s  %s blocks to go (let go and he flies himself)
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.vliegt_zelf: %s flies himself. Lean back and chonk. %s blocks to go.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.aangekomen: %s lands with a plop. You're there, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.geen: You blow. Nobody hears a thing, not even you. You don't have an Appa Guh yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.weg: You blow and blow... but your Appa Guh doesn't come. Somebody is holding him. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.komt: %s hears your whistle and comes chonking along. Yip yip!
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.zit_al: You're already sitting on him. He turns one ear toward you.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.momo_geen: You whistle very high. No Momo Guh comes: you don't have one, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.momo_al: %s is already on your shoulder and gives you a puzzled look.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.fluitje.momo_komt: %s flutters over to you. He didn't swipe anything. He says.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.schouder: %s hops onto your right shoulder. His tail tickles your neck.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.thuis: %s stays here at home and promises not to touch anything. (Sneak + click, or sneak + whistle: he comes along again.)
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.niet_van_jou: This is %s's Momo Guh. Hold on to your nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.wild: A Momo Guh without a human. He is eyeing your bag.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.vol: %s points at the ground and then at your bag. It's full, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.jat.1: %s grabs a cheese nibble from your bag and looks like he knows nothing about it.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.jat.2: Hey! %s is munching away on your shoulder. That is YOUR cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.jat.4: Something rustles in your bag. %s whistles a very innocent tune.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.momo.jat.5: %s holds up a cheese nibble: look what I found! In your bag.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.commando.gegeven: %s now has an Appa Guh (and a whistle).
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.commando.geroepen: %s's Appa Guh is on his way.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.commando.weg: %s's Appa Guh is being kept away.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.commando.jat: %s's Momo Guh borrows a cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.einde2_appa.commando.mislukt: That doesn't work for %s (no Appa Guh or Momo Guh, or nothing to do).
